about.title: Domestic flight information for the DRC, checked and dated
about.lead: Clerikaa gathers the schedules and prices of domestic flights in the DRC, route by route, so you can compare airlines before you travel. Every piece of information carries its date and its source.

figures.note: Figures computed from the data published on the site, updated every hour.

problem.title: The problem
problem.lead: Finding out who flies between two Congolese cities, on which days and at what price often takes several calls, a visit to an agency or a trip to the airport.

items.scattered: Each airline publishes its schedule its own way: a PDF timetable that changes every week, a web page, a social media post.
items.changes: Schedules change often. Information that was right last month can be wrong today, with nothing to say so.
items.prices: Prices are rarely shown publicly, and almost never with the date they were valid.
items.global: Large international travel sites sometimes show grounded airlines or closed airports.

offer.title: What you find here
offer.lead: Not just a list of flights: what you need to know to choose an airline on a route.

route.title: One page per route
route.body: The airlines that fly it, their flying days, their times and the number of flights this week, side by side.

airline.title: One page per airline on each route
airline.body: Each departure in detail: local times, stops, flight number and aircraft when they are published.

prices.title: Dated prices
prices.body: Every price shows the day it was seen and its source. A price without a date is not published.

alerts.title: The alerts that matter
alerts.body: Closed airport, suspended route, grounded airline: it is written at the top of the page concerned.

booking.title: A booking request
booking.body: On each departure, "Book this flight" sends us your request with your number. We call you back to confirm it, then pass it to a partner travel agency, which issues the ticket.

method.title: Our method
method.lead: Flight information is only useful if it is accurate. This is how we work.

collect.title: Collect at the source
collect.body: We collect schedules and prices where the airlines publish them: their timetables, their websites, their agencies. For now this work is done by hand, not by a robot.

check.title: Check before publishing
check.body: A person compares each schedule with its source before publishing it and records the date it was checked. A schedule not re-checked for 7 days is marked "To re-check".

date.title: Date and cite
date.body: Every page says when its data changed, when the schedules were checked and where they come from. Every price carries the date it was seen.

publish.title: Publish only what we know
publish.body: When we have no information on a route, the page says so ("no known flight") instead of making something up. Airlines are listed in alphabetical order, none is promoted.

limits.title: Our limits
limits.lead: Better to know them before you travel.

items.prices: Prices are indicative: the final fare is confirmed when you book.
items.live: We do not track flights in real time. Delays and last-minute cancellations do not appear here: check with the airline on the day of departure.
items.coverage: We only cover domestic flights in the DRC, and not yet every airline or every route.
items.published: Some airlines publish little information, for example no flight numbers. We show what is published, nothing more.
items.time: Times are local to each airport: the DRC has two time zones, Lubumbashi is one hour ahead of Kinshasa.
items.team: We are a small team. A mistake can slip through: if you see one, tell us.
items.tickets: We are neither an airline nor a travel agency: our job is to inform. Bookings are passed to partner agencies, which issue the tickets and are responsible for them. No payment is made on this site.
items.stats: We count visits anonymously: pages viewed, where the visit came from (Google, WhatsApp…), device type and country. No advertising, no tracking cookie, no IP address kept; the figures stay with us and our host. If your browser asks not to be tracked, nothing is counted.

intent.title: What we are aiming for
intent.p1: Listing flights is not enough. Our goal is to give, for each route, the most useful information possible: who really flies, on which days, at what recent price, and what has changed.
intent.p2: In time, we want to receive timetables directly from the airlines, for information that is even more reliable and quicker to update.

promises.dated: Every piece of information is dated.
promises.sourced: Every schedule and every price cites its source.
promises.corrected: Every report is read by a person, and the mistake is corrected as soon as we have the updated information.

join.title: Get involved
join.lead: Clerikaa improves with the people who travel, who work in aviation, or who simply want to help. Every contribution is welcome.

error.title: Report a mistake
error.body: A wrong time, a flight that no longer exists, a reopened airport: tell us the page and what changed.

share.title: Share information
share.body: A price you paid recently, a new flight, the timetable posted in an agency: with the date, it is valuable. A photo can be sent on WhatsApp.

partners.title: Airlines, airports, agencies
partners.body: Do you represent an airline, an airport or an agency? Let's talk about your schedules and how to publish them correctly.

help.title: Help with the content
help.body: Do you travel often, or work at an agency or an airport? Help us keep the schedules and prices up to date on the routes you know.
